name: Torpidity
source:
Torpidity  is a horror - romance visual novel about the happenings of Logan, an insomniac drifting through his twenties. Everything changes when Logan is kicked out by his family and moves to a new city named Candin, starting a new chapter in his life.

Why was Logan kicked out by his family?

What does the daily life of a person suffering from insomnia look like?

What secrets does the city of Candin have concealed?

[From [url=https://torpidity-team.itch.io/torpidity-game]Itch.io[/url]]
